question.text: A Cat III AIF bought NIFTY 9000 Put Option (300 lots × 75 lot size × Rs. 380 premium). Total Premium paid?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 281, the workbook table shows Nifty 9000 PE with 300 lots, lot size 75, and premium Rs. 380, producing total premium Rs. 85,50,000 (300 × 75 × 380). The Trap: The other values do not match the 300 × 75 × 380 computation shown in the workbook. Note: Per page 279, on T-day the option exposure is computed as the option premium paid, which is exactly the figure derived here.
